intro: One playthrough, about 200 hours in total. There are no difficulty trophies, no online trophies and no mission medals — the platinum is long, not hard. Work the stages in order; almost everything can be cleaned up in free-roam after the story.

stages.text: Finish the story, Chapters 1 to 5, and enjoy it. There are no mission medals to chase, so play at your own pace. Two things matter here: do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends (the one possibly missable trophy), and keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — there is no mission replay, and the game gives you 15 manual save slots for exactly this.
tips: Do the Chapter 1 meditation first (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Keep a manual save at every chapter boundary.
Take side quests as they are offered; most stay available later.
stages.title: Play the story — and save the meditation

stages.text: Finish the optional questlines for the six named characters, plus the fishing challenge with Cal. Each questline is marked automatically during the story and stays available after it, so work them in any order. These also feed the Strangers & Freaks strands and the 100 optional missions the 100% checklist wants.
tips: Andy is Lucia-only; Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only.
Randy wants 16 sports cars — scan with WAiNK before stealing.
stages.title: Side questlines — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret

stages.text: After the story, the checklist unlocks under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — and it is forgiving, closer to 60% true completion. You need any 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, all 8 large bank jobs, all 39 illegal gang operations and all 15 target decks. Most other trophies fall out while you work this list, including A Long Road itself.
tips: Scan vehicles and study animals as you go — both count early.
Bank jobs and gang operations are the big money makers too.
Skip the hardest challenges: you only need 70 of 80.
stages.title: The 100% Completion Checklist

stages.text: Finish the collectible sets and the money trophies. Cards, WAiNK scans and vehicle discovery all reward exploring, and the garage + Scooter Bros trophies turn your robbery money into property. Launder $250,000 in marked bills through fences and spend $100,000 across the shops — both happen naturally while you rob, but the counters in this atlas show exactly where you stand.
tips: Buy garages before registering vehicles to Scooter Bros.
Yasmani pays the most for marked bills.
Guns, car mods and tattoos spend $100,000 fastest.
stages.title: Collectibles and money

stages.text: Mop up whatever is left: the race and drone wins, the arcade game, the partner robberies, the combat and vehicle stunts, the secret trophies and the UFO easter egg. Check the Next up planner for the shortest path through what remains. When the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! — the platinum — pops with it.
tips: Use the Next up planner: it orders what is left by stage.
Partner trophies need both characters free-roaming together.
Three trophies are still unconfirmed — this atlas says so plainly.
stages.title: Cleanup and the platinum
